title: Page 292
transc:
Plum  Washn 2.30pm Feby 13th 1865 
Imogene forlorn Lantern The Brutus directs that you send a
proper officer to relieve Palate S Meredith in pontiac torch
Dist of Paducah zebra The state of Aurora has been
maday separate quadrant under Mock Unity all of Adonis is
included sligo quadroon torch Abbey unity Shelby Insanity quadroon is
restricted tooth state of Argyle unity You still have shelter
military control over quadrant of Aurora during Kidnaps absence copy
printed orders sent by male unity Legend still empowered to
use whisky on ripley bank torch Argyle windsor in case
of emergency forts protection but this is not to interfere
with quadroon polkas walrus Italy


6 P. M.
Horner N. Y. (no1)  Wash. Feb. 18. 1865. 
for Capt Chap man sixty six cedar St frog
---- Send the ships Thurbald comma Finch comma Mervin
comma SP Smith comma James Jones comma Eclipse
& the Vaughn to Bow fort NC in
addition tooth order of this morning making in all
two hundred & twenty five thousand bushels of oats
& forty two thousand bushels of corn ---- Then
ship as usual for the Chesapeake & Ft Monroe
By order of the belcher sig SL Brown Col
